generate.title: Logo Designer
generate.initial:
Creating the perfect logo in a single conversation with AI involves a step-by-step approach. Here's a streamlined process:

1. Define Your Vision: Start by providing key details about what you envision for your logo. Include elements like colors, shapes, themes, and any specific imagery you want.

2. Brand Personality: Describe your brand's personality and values. Is it modern and sleek, playful and fun, or perhaps vintage and classic? This helps in setting the right tone for your logo.

3. Examples for Inspiration: Share examples of logos you admire or styles you prefer. This gives context to your preferences.

4. Function and Applications: Specify how you plan to use the logo (e.g., online, print, merchandise). This can influence design choices regarding complexity and adaptability.

5. Feedback and Adjustments: Be prepared to provide feedback on initial concepts generated. Highlight what you like or dislike to refine the design.

6. Finalization: Once you have a design you love, request any final tweaks, such as color adjustments or font changes.

By articulating your vision clearly and being open to iterations, you can effectively collaborate with AI to create a compelling logo. Ready to start? Let me know what you have in mind!

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.p1: Line Embroidery is deeply committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal data. We understand that your trust is essential, and we handle your information with the utmost care.
introduction.p2: This Privacy Policy (the “Policy”) is issued on behalf of Line Embroidery, also referred to as “we”, “us”, or “our”. It explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect your personal information when you interact with our website, place orders, or engage with our services.
introduction.p3: We comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other applicable data protection laws.

scope.title: When Does This Policy Apply?
scope.p1: This Policy applies to all personal data collected through www.lineembroidery.com (the “Website”), our custom order platform, email, phone, social media, and any other communication between you and Line Embroidery.
scope.p2: This Policy does not cover the processing of employee or contractor data in the context of employment.

definitions.title: What Is Personal Data?
definitions.p1: Personal data is any information that identifies you directly or indirectly—such as your name, email, address, or order history. “Processing” includes collecting, storing, using, sharing, or deleting this data.

collection.title: How Do We Collect Personal Data?
collection.p1: We collect your data through various channels:

sources.direct: Directly from you (e.g., order forms, newsletter sign-ups, custom design requests, job applications).
sources.others: From third parties (e.g., collaborators, event partners, or referrals).
sources.public: From publicly available sources (e.g., LinkedIn, company websites).
sources.cookies: Automatically via cookies and tracking technologies.

methods.title: Specific collection scenarios include:
methods.newsletter: Subscribing to our newsletter or updates.
methods.careers: Applying for a position at Line Embroidery.
methods.events: Registering for workshops or brand events.
methods.custom: Requesting a custom embroidery design or quote.
methods.shop: Purchasing products through our online store.
methods.partnerships: Collaborating with us as a brand or retailer.
methods.media: Participating in photoshoots, events, or user-generated content.

dataCollected.title: What Personal Data Do We Collect?

identifiers.title: Personal Identifiers
identifiers.text: Name, email, phone number, shipping/billing address, company name (if applicable), and demographic details.

payment.title: Payment Details
payment.text: Credit card or bank information processed securely via third-party payment providers (e.g., Stripe, PayPal). We do not store full card numbers.

account.title: Account & Registration Details
account.text: Username, password (hashed), order history, and preferences if you create an account.

professional.title: Professional Information
professional.text: For job applicants: resume, portfolio, LinkedIn profile, and contact references.

network.title: Device & Network Activity
network.text: IP address, browser type, pages visited, time spent, and interaction data via cookies.

communication.title: Your Communications With Us
communication.text: Emails, messages, support tickets, feedback, or social media interactions.

social.title: Social Media Data
social.text: If you connect via social login (where offered), we may access your public profile info per your platform settings.

use.title: How We Use Your Personal Information

list.1: To fulfill your orders and deliver custom embroidery products.
list.2: To communicate about your order status, shipping, and support.
list.3: To operate and improve our Website and services.
list.4: To respond to your inquiries and provide customer service.
list.5: To send transactional emails (e.g., confirmations, invoices).
list.6: To share updates about new collections, events, or collaborations (with your consent).
list.7: To process payments securely through trusted partners.
list.8: To personalize your experience on our Website.
list.9: To notify you of changes to our services or policies.
list.10: To display relevant ads based on your interests (via Meta, Google, etc.).
list.11: To analyze trends and improve marketing effectiveness.
list.12: As described at the time you provide the information.
list.13: For any other purpose with your explicit consent.

candidates.title: For Job Applicants:
candidates.1: To evaluate your qualifications and fit for roles at Line Embroidery.
candidates.2: To comply with legal obligations (e.g., right-to-work checks).
candidates.3: To protect against fraud or security threats.
candidates.4: To respond to legal requests or defend our rights.
candidates.5: In emergencies, to protect the safety of our team or customers.

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.consent: Your explicit consent (e.g., for marketing emails).
legalBasis.contract: Necessary to perform a contract with you (e.g., fulfilling an order).
legalBasis.legal: To comply with legal obligations (e.g., tax laws).
legalBasis.legitimate: Our legitimate interests (e.g., fraud prevention, service improvement, direct marketing).
legalBasis.obligation: In some cases, we cannot provide our services without certain data. If so, we’ll inform you.

sharing.title: Who Has Access to Your Data?

list.1: Our internal team (only as needed to serve you).
list.2: Trusted service providers (e.g., shipping carriers, payment processors, IT support).
list.3: Affiliated companies within our corporate group.
list.4: In a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your data may be transferred as a business asset.

sharing.consent: We may share data with third parties for their marketing only with your permission. Aggregated or anonymized data may be shared publicly.

retention.title: How Long We Keep Your Data
retention.text: We retain your personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes outlined in this Policy, to comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, or enforce agreements. If processing is based on consent, we delete data when you withdraw consent.

thirdParties.title: Third-Party Processors
thirdParties.intro: We work with trusted partners to deliver our services:

list.shipping: Carriers like DHL, UPS, or local postal services.
list.hosting: Cloud and website hosting providers (e.g., Vercel, AWS).
list.marketing: Digital marketing tools (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, Mailchimp).
list.services: Invoicing, tax, and address validation tools.
list.authorities: Government or regulatory bodies when legally required.

thirdParties.controls: All third parties are contractually obligated to protect your data and use it only as instructed.
thirdParties.international: Some data may be transferred outside the EEA. We ensure adequate safeguards (e.g., Standard Contractual Clauses) are in place.
thirdParties.links: Our Website may link to third-party sites. We are not responsible for their privacy practices.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.intro: We use cookies to enhance your experience:

essential.title: Essential Cookies
essential.text: Required for basic site functionality (e.g., shopping cart, secure login).

functional.title: Functional Cookies
functional.text: Remember preferences (e.g., language, region) to personalize your visit.

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.text: Help us understand site usage (via Google Analytics) to improve performance and content.

cookies.thirdParty: Third-party cookies (e.g., from Meta or Google) may be used for advertising. Please review their privacy policies for details.

security.title: How Is My Data Secured?
security.measures: We implement technical and organizational measures (encryption, access controls, secure servers) to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.
security.user: You are responsible for keeping your account password confidential. Never share it with anyone.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.exercise: You have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict, or port your data, and to object to processing. You may withdraw consent at any time.
rights.contact: To exercise your rights, email us at privacy@lineembroidery.com.
rights.response: We’ll respond within one month (extendable by two months for complex requests).
rights.complaint: If you believe we’ve mishandled your data, you may lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.text: We may update this Policy periodically. Significant changes will be posted on our Website and/or emailed to you. Last updated: November 2024.
